summary: Control saved Home Assistant tiles from a low-power panel. Needs an account. Home Assistant must be on HTTPS.
page_description: Keep your favorite Home Assistant controls on a simple, low-power panel.
release_notes: The keyboard types every symbol now: on the ?123 keys, tap Shift for % $ ^ * [ ] { } < > \ | ~ and the backtick.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. Home Assistant must be reachable over HTTPS (Nabu Casa or a reverse proxy with a trusted certificate). Plain http:// addresses do not work.
Create a long-lived access token on your Home Assistant profile page.
Connect Home Panel from your computer. It asks for the address and the token, checks them, and sets the panel up. Open Home Panel, or tap Check again.
For a private certificate authority, install its root on the reader. Pass the same file to kobo connect with --ca.
